arxiv-1610-00422.creator: Luca Lista \fnsep
arxiv-1610-00422.description: Abstract The most accurate method to combine measurements from different experiments is to build a combined likelihood function and use it to perform the desired inference. This is not always possible for various reasons, hence approximate methods are often convenient.

arxiv-2105-07001.title: Multiwavelength investigation of the candidate Galactic PeVatron MGRO J1908+06 2020 Multiwavelength investigation of the candidate Galactic PeVatron MGRO J1908+06 – References
arxiv-2105-07001.creator: S. Crestan, A. Giuliani, S. Mereghetti, L. Sidoli, F. Pintore, N. La Palombara
arxiv-2105-07001.description: Abstract The candidate PeVatron MGRO J1908+06, which shows a hard spectrum beyond 100 TeV, is one of the most peculiar γ \gamma -ray sources in the Galactic plane. Its complex morphology and some possible counterparts spatially related with the VHE emission region, preclude to distinguish between a hadronic or leptonic nature of the γ \gamma -ray emission.

arxiv-2202-09326.title: Edge coherence in multiplex networks
arxiv-2202-09326.creator: Swati Chandna
arxiv-2202-09326.description: Abstract This paper introduces a nonparametric framework for the setting where multiple networks are observed on the same set of nodes, also known as multiplex networks. Our objective is to provide a simple parameterization which explicitly captures linear dependence between the different layers of networks.

arxiv-2410-19980.title: Molecular Fingerprints of Ice Surfaces in Sum Frequency Generation Spectra: a First Principles Machine Learning Study
arxiv-2410-19980.creator: Margaret L. Berrens, Marcos F. Calegari Andrade, John T. Fourkas, Tuan Anh Pham, Davide Donadio
arxiv-2410-19980.description: Abstract Understanding the molecular-level structure and dynamics of ice surfaces is crucial for deciphering several chemical, physical, and atmospheric processes. Vibrational sum-frequency generation (SFG) spectroscopy is the most prominent tool for probing the molecular-level structure of the air–ice interface as it is a surface-specific technique, but the molecular interpretation of SFG spectra is challenging.

PDS 70 stands out as the only system hosting a protoplanetary disk and two confirmed planets undergoing formation. It is a unique target for characterizing the dust in this type of disk. We aim to accurately measure the reflected polarized intensity and quantify the variability and asymmetry for PDS 70 across multiple epochs and wavelengths in the optical and near-infrared.

arxiv-2504-08193.title: ADJOINT-BASED OPTIMIZATION OF THE CONTROL BOUNDARIES OF A MICROFLUIDIC ACOUSTIC FLOW
arxiv-2504-08193.creator: Javier Lorente-Macias
arxiv-2504-08193.description: Abstract \vskip-12.0pt In this study, we find the optimal control boundary (i.e., actuator velocity) that cancels the acoustic reverberations inside drop-on-demand inkjet printheads at a specific time. We formulate an optimization problem to minimize the total energy of the oscillating flow at a given time (i.e., the acoustic energy inside the microchannel and the surface energy of the droplet).

arxiv-2508-16583.title: Capturing Finite Target Dynamics: Phase-Delayed Analytic Modeling of Multi-Layer Penetration Events
arxiv-2508-16583.creator: Trenton Kirchdoerfer
arxiv-2508-16583.description: Abstract The Walker-Anderson half-space penetration model has been successfully used for the rapid, efficient calculation of penetration of walls by rigid and eroding rods. These models align well with detailed simulations for thick targets; however, existing extensions for finite targets struggle to accurately capture nose-tail velocity profiles in thinner targets.

pmc-10641306.creator: Sophie Lyth, Andrea J Betancourt, Tom A R Price, Rudi L Verspoor

pmc-13204885.title: Epigenetic Evidence Implies Disturbed Proteostasis and Potentially Protein Aggregation in Suicidality
pmc-13204885.creator: Julija Šmon, Maja Juković, Matea Kršanac, Bobana Samardžija, Alja Videtič Paska, Eva Žerovnik, Katarina Kouter, Nicholas J. Bradshaw
pmc-13204885.description: Suicide is a major public health concern and cause of death worldwide. While progress has been made in understanding molecular pathways involved in suicide, much more work is needed to identify clinically useful biomarkers of suicidality. Disturbed cellular proteostasis and aggregation of specific misfolded proteins are established pathological factors of neurodegenerative diseases.

pmc-13269000.title: The Association Between Plasma Atherogenic Index Control Level and the Onset of Hypertension in Chinese Children and Adolescents
pmc-13269000.creator: Rong Lian, Yi‐de Yang, Xi‐jie Wang, Man‐man Chen, Jun Ma, Zheng‐he Wang
pmc-13269000.description: The association of atherogenic index of plasma (AIP) control level with hypertension onset in children was still unclear. This study aimed to investigate the association between AIP control levels and risk of childhood hypertension. We obtained data from 12,800 students participating in a national, multi‐center, school‐based health lifestyle intervention program aimed at combating obesity.

pmc-13352423.title: Cost and cost-effectiveness of Mohs micrographic surgery versus conventional excision for nonmelanoma skin cancer: A scoping review
pmc-13352423.creator: Mehdi Boostani, Kimberly L. Brady, Michael J. Bax, Kegon T.K. Tan, Nathalie C. Zeitouni, Cerrene N. Giordano, Gyorgy Paragh
pmc-13352423.description: BackgroundNonmelanoma skin cancers (NMSCs) are commonly treated with conventional excision (CE) or Mohs micrographic surgery (MMS), but their relative cost-effectiveness remains uncertain.ObjectiveTo summarize the available economic evidence comparing MMS and CE for NMSC and, secondarily, to identify methodological gaps that limit interpretation of comparative cost-effectiveness.MethodsWe performed a scoping review of EMBASE, Scopus, PubMed, and Cochrane (January 11, 2025).

pmc-13669206.creator: Jiaxian Zheng, Liqiang Zhang, Haoqi Ni, Shuozhen Chen, Xiangfeng Lin, Liwei Wang, Zhanhui Yuan
pmc-13669206.description: Conventional evaporators suffer from poor mechanical strength, salt crystallization, and degradation in sea water. We design a white polyorganosiloxane‐based solar evaporator (PDMSE) that exploits siliconeʼs unique attributes. These include chemical inertness, anti‑corrosion, high flexibility, and chemical resistance. Such characteristics ensure structural integrity and anti‑fouling performance under harsh brine conditions.
